# Vision test fixture

`hand.jpg` is the image used by Google's official MediaPipe Hand Landmarker Python example:

- [Official example](https://github.com/google-ai-edge/mediapipe-samples/blob/main/examples/hand_landmarker/python/hand_landmarker.ipynb)
- [Image hosted by Google](https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-tasks/hand_landmarker/woman_hands.jpg)
- [Original image credited by the example](https://unsplash.com/photos/mt2fyrdXxzk)

This is used solely as a local integration test fixture. It is not included in the production application.
